rules.label: ZIP+4 printed
rules.note: USPS introduced ZIP+4 in 1983; treat as a lower bound.

rules.label: U.S. ZIP code printed
rules.note: ZIP Code launched July 1, 1963; adoption lag means absence is not evidence.

rules.label: Telephone exchange name
rules.note: Named exchanges such as PLaza or SO 2-4550 are mid-century cues, not exact dates.

rules.label: North American area code
rules.note: NANP area-code implementation began in the early 1950s; use as a lower bound.

rules.label: Diners Club accepted
rules.note: Diners Club launched the first multipurpose charge card in 1950.

rules.label: American Express accepted
rules.note: American Express charge-card acceptance is a post-1958 marker.

rules.label: BankAmericard accepted
rules.note: BankAmericard was introduced in 1958 and became Visa in 1976.

rules.label: Master Charge accepted
rules.note: Interbank became Master Charge in 1969 and MasterCard in 1979.

rules.label: MasterCard accepted
rules.note: MasterCard branding is a post-1979 marker.

rules.label: Website or email printed
rules.note: Public website/email presentation is treated as a conservative 1990s-or-later marker.
